author: pk910
content:
I've created a `lean-sphincs-tx` scenario for spamoor and started it on daisugi-devnet-0. Targeting 5 txs per block, which is already very heavy work on the signer side..
Gives the network some work,  some signature aggregations. Looks stable so far 🙂

author: barnabasbusa
content: how big are these sigs? are they heavy compute wise or p2p wise?

author: pk910
content: heavy compute wise.   spamoor sits at 1.5-1.7 cores for these 5txs per block 😄

author: pk910
content: the stark proof in the block is about 250kB,  it doesn't really differ with 1 vs 5 transactions.

author: ansgar.eth
content: thread for discussing to what extent Hegota should aim to make transactions with pq signatures cheaper (data and verification) than they would naively (no aggregation, no precompiles) be.
